objective.summary: Check whether a search request carrying the original SQL-injection-shaped text can still make the search return records beyond the legitimate search match.

preconditions.detail: The Phase 12 plan satisfies the plan contract; its proposals are PROPOSED, not applied.
The plan is for the incident being validated.
The scenario is not approved for execution (review status 'pending_human_review'; open blocking ambiguities: 5).
No attestation that the remediation was applied was supplied; a proposal is not an applied remediation.
The scope policy denied: no_approved_lab, target_missing, scenario_not_eligible, lab_identity_missing, operator_authorization_missing.
Live validation is not implemented in Phase 13A; nothing is executed.

limitations: A validation result describes only the lab state, scenario, request and conditions that were actually tested. It is not a universal security guarantee and it does not mean residual risk is zero.
A failed or absent attack observation is not proof that the objective is unachievable: other payloads, encodings, endpoints or states were not tested.
A proposed remediation is not an applied remediation. Phase 13 does not apply remediation; whether and how one was applied is stated by the attestation recorded here and is not verified by Phase 13.
The free-text validation procedure written by the Phase 12 planner is never interpreted or executed.

The original objective comes from an operator-side metadata file, not from a model and not from the evaluation answer key. It describes the attack that was generated in the lab, which may not be what a real attacker would try.
Phase 13A performs no live validation: no check ran, no traffic was sent and nothing here demonstrates that any remediation is effective.
One probe value and one endpoint: not a survey of SQL-injection techniques.
The oracle looks at returned records only; it does not detect error-based, blind or second-order injection.
The definition was extracted by an AI assistant and has had no human review.
validity_conditions: No check ran, so this report is valid only as a statement of WHY no validation result exists.
It reflects the inputs supplied at that time; any change to the plan, scenario, attestation or scope configuration requires a new report.
